module.name: no-conditional-test-assertion
module.description: Reports test assertions inside branches that can be skipped while allowing conditional test data preparation.

scenarios.name: should allow conditional setup with an unconditional assertion
scenarios.given: a test selects its input conditionally and asserts after the branch
scenarios.when: the rule checks the assertion ancestry

scenarios.name: should allow assertions in guaranteed nonempty loops
scenarios.given: a for-of loop iterates an array literal with a fixed element
scenarios.when: the rule checks the loop body
scenarios.then: no violation is reported because the body executes at least once

scenarios.name: should ignore unrelated and shadowed assertion bindings
scenarios.given: expect or assert is imported from another package or shadowed locally

scenarios.name: should ignore non-test files and matcher-free expect calls
scenarios.given: the source is not a test file or expect has no matcher member

scenarios.name: should report assertions in if ternary logical and switch branches
scenarios.given: a supported assertion occurs in a potentially skipped branch
scenarios.when: the rule walks the assertion ancestry

scenarios.name: should report assertions in catch callbacks and loop bodies
scenarios.given: an assertion occurs in a catch clause, promise catch callback, or loop body
scenarios.when: the rule checks whether the body may run zero times

scenarios.name: should report imported and computed assertion forms
scenarios.given: Jest, Vitest, Chai, Sinon, or Node assert assertions use aliases, Vitest local test context, namespace access, or computed properties
scenarios.when: the rule resolves the assertion binding across formatting variations
